baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَكَادُ ... لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ joins near-completion, causative slipping, and the eyes as instrument.
baseline_models.mechanism: A hostile gaze acts like loss of traction: it applies enough pressure to approach bodily or social displacement, while يَكَادُ holds the result at a threshold rather than reporting completion.

activation_trace.role: The nearly-doing image supplies the threshold that keeps the attempted displacement just short of completion.
The slippery surface on which a foot cannot hold supplies the mechanics of induced loss of position.
Literal ocular seeing identifies the eyes as the channel through which the destabilizing pressure is applied.

changed_reading.before: They look at the addressee with extreme hostility.
changed_reading.after: Their looking is an almost-effective operation of traction loss that tries to remove the addressee from a bodily, social, or discursive position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal sequence لَمَّا سَمِعُوا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ makes hearing the reminder the input and the madness claim the output.
baseline_models.mechanism: Audible reception fails to become understanding or compliance. The reminder is instead rerouted through public speech into a diagnosis that represents the speaker's cognition as veiled.

activation_trace.role: Hearing sound supplies the literal sensory input that immediately precedes the hostile response.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the unrealized receptive outcome against which their reaction is measured.
The reminder or admonition image makes what is heard a cognition-addressing prompt rather than undifferentiated sound.
Circulating public talk turns the spoken madness label into a repeatable social verdict rather than a private thought.
Madness as a veil over the mind supplies the content of the diagnosis produced by the failed reception.

changed_reading.before: They hear the reminder and then utter an insult.
changed_reading.after: The ayah maps a failed reception pipeline: sound enters, understanding is refused, and the reminder is converted into a circulating diagnosis of its bearer.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ and لَمَجْنُونٌ place two covering images on opposite sides of an intervening act of sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: Those characterized by covering or rejecting truth use their own visual judgment to claim that another person's mind is covered. The accusation therefore mirrors, and may externalize, the obscuration named in the agents.

activation_trace.role: Concrete covering supplies the obscuring action associated with the agents.
Covering or rejecting truth locates the agents' obscuration specifically in their response to what is presented as true.
Inner sight and certainty make their gaze an implicit claim to epistemic penetration, not only ocular force.
The veiled-mind image returns covering as the predicate they assign to the addressee.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers correctly see a person and falsely call him mad.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages rival claims about hidden cognition: agents marked by covering deploy sight to project a second covering onto the mind they oppose.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping of يَكَادُ permits a non-dominant ك ي د shadow alongside the dominant near-action construction, while gaze and speech form two coordinated channels.
baseline_models.mechanism: The near-slip can be carried not only as spontaneous intensity but as a two-part stratagem: ocular pressure attempts to remove footing and verbal judgment attempts to fix a disqualifying identity.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant plotting and stratagem image supplies a coordinated-plan shadow without replacing the ordinary near-action force.
Slipping supplies the stratagem's first operation: removal of stable position.
Seeing with the eye supplies the first channel of the proposed coordinated pressure.
Arrogating judgment over someone supplies the second operation: imposing a status after attempting displacement.

changed_reading.before: A fierce look and an insult happen together in anger.
changed_reading.after: The look and the label coexist as a possible coordinated strategy for first destabilizing and then socially classifying the addressee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet surrounds the focus with writing, aligned lines, a book under study, and a final reminder. Against that durable and repeatable textual order, ocular pressure attempts to turn the addressee's footing into a surface on which no position holds.

activation_trace.role: The smooth surface with failed traction supplies the destabilizing pole of the contrast.
The reminder image identifies the content whose bearer is being pressured.
The trimmed writing implement supplies durable inscription as an alternative to the opponents' momentary gaze.
The aligned written line supplies stable ordering that materially contrasts with slipping out of place.
Joined letters and the written object extend the stable textual substrate through the context.
Following a book through reading and retention supplies reproducible scrutiny rather than verdict by glare.
The closing reminder broadens the focus object beyond the immediate encounter and preserves it after the attempted displacement.

structural_cues: The pen-and-lines opening, book-and-study questions, and closing reminder form an inscription-to-recollection frame around the focus encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, study, reminder, and slipping; I infer a contrast between textual stability and induced loss of footing. A live alternative is that the writing cues establish authority without participating in the spatial mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The opponents try to unsettle one speaker in a fleeting confrontation.
changed_reading.after: Their gaze tries to dislodge the bearer of a reminder whose written, studied, and repeatable form is structurally harder to move than its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier image of being upon a great inward disposition and the later making of a person fit among the righteous give the threatened slip an ethical axis: hostile attention attempts to push the addressee off a maintained manner of being.

activation_trace.role: Literal traction loss supplies the analogical movement away from a stable ethical position.
Inner disposition supplies the nonphysical footing from which the hostile gaze would try to dislodge the addressee.
Magnitude and strength make that ethical footing substantial rather than fragile.
Fitness or suitability supplies the later confirmation of a maintained, properly fitted station.

structural_cues: The preposition in لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ depicts an 'upon' relation that can coexist with the focus ayah's attempted slip.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward disposition, strength, fitness, and physical slipping; I infer an ethical vertical axis on which pressure seeks to move the addressee. Bodily or social displacement remains an equally live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The gaze threatens bodily balance or public standing.
changed_reading.after: The gaze also threatens a forced departure from the great disposition on which the addressee is said to stand, while the context presents that station as fitted and maintained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing, knowing, and reminder cues sharpen the gap between sensory access and cognition. The opponents physically hear and look, yet neither hearing becomes compliant understanding nor sight becomes inner discernment; both channels are redirected into attack.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance supply the semantic completion that their literal hearing fails to reach.
Inner sight supplies the epistemic completion that their weaponized eyes fail to perform.
The context's reciprocal future seeing keeps discernment contested rather than settled by the opponents' present stare.
Knowledge as disclosure, negated in this occurrence, supplies the explicit boundary on the opponents' awareness.
The reminder's continued identity confirms that hostile reception does not convert it into the diagnosis uttered against its bearer.

structural_cues: The focus sequence moves from hearing to ocular aggression to speech, while 68:5, 68:44, and 68:52 repeatedly reopen seeing, knowing, and reminding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sensory and epistemic branches for the same roots; I infer that the absent transition from sensation to understanding is functional. The live alternative is a simpler sequence of literal hearing, looking, and speaking with no failed-faculty model.

changed_reading.before: People hear a message, look angrily, and reject its speaker.
changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses cross-modal epistemic failure: ears receive without understanding, eyes operate without insight, and speech converts that failure into an accusation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier wish for reciprocal oiling or soft accommodation materially activates the focus slip. A concession that smooths relations can also remove traction, so the desired compromise and the later attempted dislodging become two phases of one surface-changing mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Oil and coating supply the literal lubricant that can turn a stable surface into one that slips.
Soft accommodation supplies the social action whose material analogue is lubrication.
The non-gripping surface converts social smoothing into the mechanics of lost footing.
Oiling and polishing until smooth supplies the unusually exact material bridge between accommodation and slipping.
Near-completion keeps the proposed lubricating mechanism active but visibly unconsummated.

structural_cues: The reciprocal morphology of تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ presents mutual smoothing, whereas the later causative لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ directs the resulting instability toward one party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oil, accommodation, polishing, and slipping; I infer that concession changes the social surface and enables displacement. The live alternative is that appeasement and ocular aggression are separate behaviors joined only by a cross-domain branch analogy.

changed_reading.before: Compromise is one rejected proposal, and the later gaze is a separate hostile act.
changed_reading.after: The requested compromise can be carried as preparatory lubrication: what looks like mutual smoothing would remove the addressee's traction and make one-sided displacement possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fault-finding is made mobile through a walking carrier whose speech escapes as slander, while the message is pre-labeled as false stories. The focus madness claim is therefore the compact output of a reputational circuit, and the hostile gaze functions as public scrutiny within it.

activation_trace.role: Faulting and attacking people's reputation supplies the circuit's motive and evaluative content.
Walking with tale-bearing supplies the carrier that moves the hostile judgment between people.
Speech escaping as slander supplies the transmitted payload of the reputational mechanism.
The false-stories image supplies an earlier dismissive label applied when the signs are recited.
Hearing as reputation and public circulation turns reception into a social broadcast channel.
Circulating talk supplies the public persistence of the final madness label.
The veiled-mind diagnosis supplies the reputational circuit's terminal classification.

structural_cues: The participial sequence at 68:11 compresses faulting, movement, and tale-bearing into one social actor.
The branchless و س م occurrence at 68:16 contributes only the structural cue of a public mark following the false-story label; no branch image is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies faulting, mobile tale-bearing, escaped slander, false-story labeling, and circulating speech; I infer a coordinated stigma circuit. A live alternative is that these are separate portraits of opponents rather than stages in one transmission mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The words 'he is mad' are a local insult uttered at the moment of hearing.
changed_reading.after: The madness claim is a portable reputational label generated by an existing faulting-and-rumor system, with hostile looking adding visible social pressure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence moves from cutting resolve and secret speech to barring entry, then reverses through sight into the agents' own recognition of loss and deprivation. This gives the focus threat a rebound pattern: those trying to remove another's footing may become the ones who lose possession and orientation.

activation_trace.role: Near-action holds the attempted removal at the point where reversal can intervene.
Loss of traction supplies the threatened removal of another's position.
Ocular seeing links the focus attack to the garden agents' later reversal through sight.
Cutting and separation supply the group's intended operation of severing produce and access.
Lowered secret speech supplies covert coordination of the exclusion project.
Literal entry supplies the access that the group plans to deny.
Seeing with eye and insight supplies the moment at which their exclusion plan reverses into self-recognition.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired object make the intended excluders the deprived party.

structural_cues: The ordered narrative runs from oath and covert movement to exclusion, sight, self-naming as lost, and acknowledgment of deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exclusion project that rebounds into the agents' own loss; I transfer that directional reversal to the focus attempt to dislodge. The live alternative is that the garden narrative illustrates moral consequence without specifying the focus gaze's mechanics.

changed_reading.before: The opponents nearly succeed in removing the addressee from his position.
changed_reading.after: Their attempted exclusion sits inside a context where removal projects reverse: the agents who aim to deny footing and access become disoriented and deprived themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questions about judgment, binding text, guarantorship, and truth recast 'he is mad' as an adjudication without warrant. The opponents do not merely abuse the addressee; they arrogate authority to define his cognitive status without a document, accountable guarantor, or truth test.

activation_trace.role: Arrogating judgment over another supplies the legal force hidden inside the spoken label.
A statement functioning as definition or essence supplies the classificatory form of 'he is mad.'
The veiled-mind category supplies the status their unauthorized definition assigns.
Judgment between parties supplies the judicial frame in which their classification must answer for its authority.
Binding inscription that establishes a rule supplies the absent documentary warrant for their verdict.
Bearing a guarantee supplies the accountable sponsor whom the context demands for the asserted judgment.
Truthful speech supplies the test that the madness classification has not itself established.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف occurrence at 68:36 contributes only the interrogative challenge to how they judge; no branch inventory is imputed to it.
The sequence asks for their judgment, book, guarantor, partners, and truth before the focus reports their categorical speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained cross-examination of judgment and warrants plus a focus statement that classifies a mind; I infer an unauthorized verdict. A live alternative is that the statement remains abuse rather than a quasi-legal act.

changed_reading.before: 'He is mad' is an emotionally charged insult.
changed_reading.after: 'He is mad' is also an unwarranted adjudication: the opponents claim power to define a person's mind while the context strips their judgment of text, guarantor, and demonstrated truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A vertical reversal joins the scenes. In the focus, their eyes are instruments meant to cast another off balance; in the preceding scene, those same possessed eyes are lowered while abasement overtakes their owners. The direction of ocular force rebounds.

activation_trace.role: Ocular seeing supplies the instrument aimed outward in the focus attack.
Slipping supplies the intended downward or outward movement imposed on the addressee.
Lowering and submission supply the vertical posture to which the opponents are called but cannot enact.
Lowered subjection supplies the condition that now governs their own gaze.
The same literal eye-root identifies the outward weapon with the later humbled organ.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the reversed force that covers the hostile lookers themselves.
Brokenness under force supplies the condition that replaces their attempted mastery over another's balance.

structural_cues: The possessive 'their eyes' recurs: first as eyes already lowered at 68:43 and then as the instrument by which they seek to dislodge at 68:51.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same eyes in opposed vertical relations; I infer a deliberate rebound from casting down to being cast low. The live alternative is temporal juxtaposition without a transferred direction of force.

changed_reading.before: Their gaze exerts one-way power over the addressee.
changed_reading.after: The gaze belongs to a reversive vertical contest: eyes that seek to cast another down are themselves shown lowered and overtaken by abasement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opponents' apparent near-success occupies an immediate timescale, while gradual taking, extended respite, and a firm stratagem occupy a slower counter-timescale. Delay is therefore active: they try to move the addressee suddenly while they are themselves moved degree by degree without knowing it.

Sudden traction loss supplies the fast displacement they attempt against the addressee.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the slow displacement operating on the opponents.
Granting and extending time makes the delay an enabled interval rather than absence of action.
Explicit stratagem supplies the enclosing counter-plan within which the opponents' attempted slip occurs.
Extended solidity supplies durability to the slower strategy and contrasts with unstable footing.

structural_cues: The sequence 'take them by degrees,' 'give them time,' and 'my stratagem is firm' precedes the focus construction of near-success.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gradual taking, respite, firm strategy, near-action, and slipping; I infer nested timescales with reversed objects of displacement. The live alternative is that 68:44-45 states eventual consequence without changing the immediate force of 68:51.

changed_reading.before: Their failure to complete the attack is merely a narrow miss.
changed_reading.after: Their near-success is nested inside a slower counter-movement: while they try to dislodge suddenly, respite lets a firm strategy move them imperceptibly by degrees.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby counterfactual trajectory runs from constricted containment toward being cast into exposed space, but catching grace interrupts it and selection reverses casting-away into drawing-near. The focus's almost-slip inherits this grammar of an expulsion brought to the threshold and blocked.

Slipping from place supplies the focus form of threatened expulsion.
A blocked outlet after fullness supplies the initial state of pressure held inside.
Catching up to and reaching supplies the interrupting action that prevents the projected cast-out endpoint.
Beneficent good condition identifies grace as the supplied means of interception.
Throwing and casting supplies the unrealized endpoint parallel to being made to slip away.
Open space without cover supplies the exposure into which the counterfactual casting would deliver its object.
Selection and drawing near reverse the direction from expulsion into chosen proximity.

structural_cues: The unrealized لَنُبِذَ after لَوْلَا and the focus's near-action construction both project displacement without asserting its completion.
The sequence moves from pressure and possible casting-out through interception to selection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two noncompleted displacement constructions plus catch, cast, exposure, and selection; I infer a shared protective-interception grammar. The live alternative is that the nearby episode only instructs patience and does not specify why the focus slip fails.

strongest_changes: The focus became a failed reception mechanism in which hearing does not become understanding and sight does not become insight, so both senses are redirected into diagnosis and attack.
The attempted slip became reversive: lowered hostile eyes, the garden excluders' deprivation, and gradual counter-displacement all turn force back toward its agents.
The nearby catch-cast-exposure-selection sequence changed near-slipping from a narrow miss into an intercepted expulsion trajectory.
The requested mutual oiling unexpectedly activated a material model in which accommodation smooths away traction and enables one-sided displacement.
summary.what_was_special: The trace was driven by cross-domain branch contacts that a single paraphrase would erase: written line versus slippery surface, social oiling versus traction loss, ocular height versus lowered eyes, and casting-out versus selection. Split-root shadows preserved coordinated stratagem and speech-as-instability without displacing the dominant readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The force of بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ can remain bodily, affective, reputational, or analogically terrain-changing; the packet does not force one domain.
The ك و د to ك ي د and ق و ل to ق ل ل split activations are productive but must remain secondary to the dominant mappings.
The oiling/slipping and stone-ground/slippery-ground links may be deliberate material mechanisms or only branch-enabled resonances.
The context strongly supports reversal and interception, but it does not uniquely specify what prevents the focus displacement from completing.
